column2: According to Gary Niemen of Spotify, the Golden Path, as Spotify defines it today, is the "opinionated and supported" path to "build something", for example a backend service, a website or a data pipeline. The Golden Path tutorial is a step-by-step tutorial that walks through that path. The tools on the path are visualized in the Explore section of Backstage, Spotify's internal developer portal, with filtering per discipline. The post says the idea is not to limit or stifle engineers, or to set standards for the sake of it: with Golden Paths in place, teams do not have to reinvent the wheel and have fewer decisions to make.

According to the same post by Gary Niemen, the first Golden Path and tutorial were developed for backend engineering as a Hack Week project. It quotes the platform team's write-up, which says an engineer can leave the Golden Path and do their own thing, but then will not have the same support.
